rrrocket 0.11.8 / Boxcars 0.13.0
Upstream: https://github.com/nickbabcock/rrrocket/releases/tag/v0.11.8
License: MIT; see LICENSE.txt.

Unmodified official release archives are distributed with the source repository
and Python package. SHA256 digests are pinned in infrastructure/replays/runtime.py.
The host-specific executable is unpacked locally on first use; no download is needed.
To update, replace the versioned archives and pinned hashes together, retain the
license, and run replay-name and packaging validation before deployment.
